title: 第21章 战神九凤巫族祖地第22章 帝江一怒山河震撼
slug: 洪荒我在截教结算证道
content_zh:
“九凤大巫！”
李玄霄心口一震，握着手中这枚戒指，只觉得烫得惊人。
他怎么也没想到，九凤竟会把那射日神弓和夸父不朽巫身，甚至那储物戒指和那一滴祖巫精血都尽数托付给他这个只有两面之缘的截教弟子。
“别废话了！”
九凤见他犹豫，眼中厉色一闪，厉声传音：“你留在这里，只会让我分心！你能安全把东西带到巫族祖地，就是帮了我最大的忙！”
话音落下的瞬间，九凤猛地将他往后一推，周身巫族精血轰然燃烧！
赤红的巫煞冲天而起，竟是真的将那重重禁制和阵法都轰开了一个口子！
见李玄霄出了口子，她手中刀出鞘，带着燃尽一切的杀伐之气，朝着五位大罗金仙悍然杀去！
“想走？哪有那么容易！”
那为首女仙冷声一喝，四人同时出手，冰魄仙光交织成网，朝着李玄霄笼罩而去。
可她们没想到，九凤根本没有半分防守的意思，完全是搏命的打法，刀刀都是以伤换伤，根本不在意自身会不会被仙光击中，只求将四人的注意力，死死锁在自己身上。
但这四人还欲去追。
“莫要本末倒置！我等齐力斩杀九凤！让手下人去追那个真仙！”
这时，那妖圣鬼车一声爆喝。
但与此同时！
“轰！”
一声巨响传来。
九凤一刀挥出，竟是将整个会场都瞬间崩碎了大半，顿时玉石飞溅，石柱倒塌。
但这时，已有一位女仙杀到身前。
九凤丝毫不惧，反手一刀，就逼得其连连后退。

李玄霄看着身后的九凤，心中莫名有些憋屈，一念之间，青霄剑已然出现在李玄霄手中。
九凤见李玄霄还要留下作战，忙喝道：“速走！我自有保命手段！莫要再停留了！”
“嗯？”
“我自有保命之法！你且速走，能脱困去巫族祖地搬来救兵是为最好！”
九凤再次喝道。
见九凤这般决绝，李玄霄倒也没有再犹豫。
毕竟，再犹豫就和那些烂俗的影视片一般了，犹犹豫豫坏了大事！
“九凤大巫保重！等我搬来救兵！”
李玄霄背后风雷双翅瞬间展开，青金色的风雷之力催动到极致，风雷搅动，化作一道肉眼难辨的流光，瞬息冲了出去！
见李玄霄已逃出，九凤舔了舔嘴角的鲜血。
“倒是许久没有好好战一场了！”
九凤眼中杀意更盛，周身的煞气愈发狂暴。
她本就是一场场血战里杀出来的凶人，哪怕面对五位大罗金仙她也只觉得战意盎然！
此刻，整个蓬莱岛，已然彻底被惊动。
护岛大阵全面启动，无数守卫朝着道珍会场这边赶来。
content_en:
"Nine Phoenix Great Witch!"
Li Xuanxiao's heart was shocked. He held the ring in his hand and felt it was surprisingly hot.
He never expected that Jiufeng would entrust the sun-shooting bow, Kuafu's immortal witch body, even the storage ring and the drop of ancestral witch essence and blood to him, a disciple of the Jie Cult who only had a relationship with him.
"Stop talking nonsense!"
Seeing his hesitation, Jiu Feng's eyes flashed with a stern expression, and she spoke sternly: "You will only distract me if you stay here! You have done me the greatest favor by being able to safely bring things to the ancestral land of the Wu Clan!"
The moment the words fell, Jiufeng pushed him back violently, and the witch essence and blood around him burned!
The crimson shaman soared into the sky, and actually blasted a hole through all the restrictions and formations!
Seeing that Li Xuanxiao had made a mistake, she unsheathed the knife in her hand, and with all the murderous aura, she headed towards the five Great Luo Golden Immortals to kill them!
"Want to leave? It's not that easy!"
The leading female immortal shouted coldly, and the four of them took action at the same time. The ice soul fairy light intertwined into a net and shrouded Li Xuanxiao.
But they didn't expect that Jiufeng had no intention of defending at all, and was completely fighting for his life. He exchanged injuries for injuries with his swords. He didn't care at all whether he would be hit by the fairy light. He just wanted to lock the four people's attention on him.
But these four people still wanted to pursue him.
"Don't put the cart before the horse! Let's work together to kill Jiufeng! Let our men chase the true immortal!"
At this time, the demon saint ghost car roared loudly.
But at the same time!
"Boom!"
There was a loud noise.
Jiufeng swung out his sword and shattered most of the entire venue in an instant. Immediately, jade stones flew into the air and stone pillars collapsed.
But at this time, a female fairy came to kill him.
Jiufeng was not afraid at all, and with a backhand strike, he was forced to retreat.
Li Xuanxiao looked at Jiufeng behind him, feeling a little aggrieved inexplicably. In a flash, the Qingxiao Sword appeared in Li Xuanxiao's hand.
Seeing that Li Xuanxiao wanted to stay and fight, Jiufeng shouted: "Leave quickly! I have my own means of saving my life! Don't stay any longer!"
"Huh?"
"I have my own way to save my life! You should leave quickly. It would be best if you can get out of trouble and go to the ancestral land of the Wu clan to bring reinforcements!"
Jiufeng shouted again.
Seeing Jiufeng's determination, Li Xuanxiao did not hesitate any longer.
After all, if you hesitate any longer, it will be just like those vulgar movies and TV shows. Hesitation will ruin a big thing!
"Take care, Jiufeng Great Witch! Wait for me to move in to help you!"
The wind and thunder wings behind Li Xuanxiao instantly spread out, and the green-gold wind and thunder power was pushed to the extreme. The wind and thunder stirred and turned into a stream of light that was difficult to distinguish with the naked eye, and rushed out in an instant!
Seeing that Li Xuanxiao had escaped, Jiufeng licked the blood from the corner of his mouth.
"It's been a long time since I had a good fight!"
Jiufeng's eyes became more murderous, and the evil energy around him became more violent.
She was a murderer who was killed in bloody battles. Even when facing five Daluo Golden Immortals, she only felt full of fighting spirit!
At this moment, the entire Penglai Island was completely alarmed.
The island protection formation was fully activated, and countless guards rushed towards the Daozhen venue.
